what: Inside the slot, a 20-sided die (icosahedron · FOV 42° · camera z 3 · 146px canvas) with one face tilted forward (x axis atan(1/φ)) slowly spins around the z axis at .55rad per second while visible on screen. Pressing launches it out of the slot at sideways ±14 · upward 10~24px/frame speed, and dragging past 12px makes it follow the hand, then it is thrown at 1.15x the release speed (±35, previous value .35 + new value .65). In flight, each frame gravity .9px, sideways .995x and rotation .985x damp it, and it bounces off screen edges at −.6x (floor −.55 · sideways .78 · rotation .82x). When it rests on the floor for over 6 frames or 720 frames pass, .48s later it emits fx:land with the number of the face looking up, returns to the slot over .7s power3.inOut and spins again

options.fx:land: Event fired by the element attached after stopping — detail.face is the number of the face looking up (the original uses that number to pick and open a work item)

use: — Load three-global.js before three.cjs
note: Drag-and-throw is this part’s job, so touch-action: none blocks page scroll over the cells — use the cells only as small plates around 146px and don’t let them cover the screen height. Number font is --kf-font-display italic

from.where: shared.js drawer dice tile .ps-dice-tile — original ProjectsDiceD20 (two-tone mint faces · ink-black numbers)
